cot_history.reasoning_cot: My strategy prioritizes survival (HP) and adapts to supply scarcity. Initially, I bid based on my HP and supply. After Day 1, I analyze opponent `previous_trace` to identify their highest bid and HP status, adjusting my bid to outcompete struggling opponents or match high bids when my HP is low, while conserving budget when healthy or supply is abundant.

Strategy prioritizes survival: bid high when HP is low or no-water-days are high, react to yesterday's highest opponent bid, and conserve budget when HP is good.
